summary: Frontend-only testing of bug fix for 'Error al ejecutar insertBefore en Node' (DOM/web error) when creating/editing businesses on web preview. Verified the fix across all 3 flows: (1) FIRST business creation from /onboarding -> /business-form -> Guardar -> redirected to /(tabs) with ARGENTEA active in top switcher; (2) SECOND business creation from /business-form while on tabs -> saved -> redirected to /(tabs); (3) EDIT existing business via /business-form?id=XXX -> saved. In ALL THREE flows: ZERO `insertBefore` errors in page errors AND zero in console errors. Fix is confirmed working. Also verified: auto_rate chip 'Automática' toggles correctly (manual=24.50, auto fetched=26.8995 from /api/fx/usd-hnl), Lempiras rate field only visible when currency='L' (hidden when currency='USD', shown again on switch back). Authentication was bypassed by seeding a user+user_sessions row in MongoDB test_database per /app/memory/test_credentials.md and setting localStorage.mn_session_token before load (AuthProvider on web calls /api/auth/me with the stored token). Test data cleaned up after run.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix in business-form.tsx is sound: removed chained switchBusiness+navigation (which caused simultaneous invalidateQueries + stack replace in same microtask on react-native-web, leading to insertBefore DOM errors). setTimeout(0) defers navigation past React reconciliation. BusinessProvider's auto-select effect (/app/frontend/src/business-context.tsx:48-63) correctly picks up the new/first business once /api/businesses refetches, so UX is preserved.
Conditional 'Tasa L -> USD' field is now rendered as a single conditional block (no sibling fragment issue). Verified visibility toggle on currency switch works clean.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To test auth-gated frontend flows: seed user + user_sessions in MongoDB test_database (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md), then page.goto(/) and page.evaluate(`localStorage.setItem('mn_session_token','<token>')`) BEFORE a second goto. AuthProvider (web branch) on mount calls /api/auth/me with the token and sets user. The AuthGate then permits /onboarding or /(tabs) based on business list. Capture page.on('pageerror') AND page.on('console') to catch react-native-web DOM errors (insertBefore). The business-form screen uses FormScreen component which renders a 'Guardar' button with testID='form-save'. The onboarding entry is testID='onboarding-create'. Business switcher chip in dashboard shows active business name. Pre-existing RN warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) are noise, filter them out when hunting for real errors.
rca_of_issue: Original 'insertBefore' error root cause: in createMut.onSuccess the code called await switchBusiness(id) which synchronously invalidated ALL queries, then IMMEDIATELY called router.replace('/(tabs)'), causing react-native-web to reconcile a tree where parent containers were being unmounted (navigation stack transition) while child portals/modals were still mounting newly-fetched data - the DOM mutation order mismatched between React and the actual DOM, triggering 'Failed to execute insertBefore on Node'. Fix: (1) removed redundant switchBusiness - BusinessProvider has an auto-select effect that picks the first business when activeId is null; (2) wrapped router.replace/back in setTimeout(_, 0) to defer navigation past the current reconciliation flush; (3) collapsed sibling fragment/ternary <Text> nodes in the conditional Tasa L->USD field to a single conditional block avoiding keyless sibling reorder on toggle. Verification: created 2 businesses + 1 edit, zero insertBefore errors in page errors or console errors, flows end on /(tabs) with correct active business.
